name: Puck
biography: Puck is a 19-year-old rising junior computer science major and Cicada 3301 puzzle enthusiast. He has been involved in the community for four years, finding inspiration to pursue cryptography and cybersecurity. Puck has focused his work on promoting community solving efforts, mainly in the form of innovative events.
